join_policy: preserve explicit subject/predicate/object, record boundaries and time; common keys are candidates requiring compatible meaning; never equate people by task membership

state_definitions.after: Record observed after a service write call, or a desired write-state in a request. Check effect_status.
state_definitions.before: Record observed before this service has completed any write call in the task; it need not be modified later.
state_definitions.effect_status: requested is an outgoing request, not a successful write; error gives no successful record.
state_definitions.record_path: RFC 6901 pointer into parsed content of the exact receiver/event/direction message, not a list position in another message.
state_definitions.unknown: The visible tool semantics or source record do not establish its state.
